items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: At stretching portion of Friday's practice
items.text:
Tuten (ankle/foot) was present for the stretching portion of Friday's practice before moving to a side field, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Trending toward Sunday start
items.text:
Mayfield (foot) is trending in the right direction to start Sunday's game against the Lions after looking good in Friday's practice, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Set to miss a "couple months, " per coach
items.text:
Coach Sean McVay revealed Friday that Nacua (knee) had surgery to repair his MCL on Tuesday and is on track to miss a couple of months, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.
